style: Match Image 1 (the approved Store design) exactly: same glossy casual mobile puzzle style, chunky rounded shapes, soft bevels, warm cream and gold palette, thick soft outlines, clean edges. Produce a single isolated game UI asset, centered, nothing else in the frame.

items.name: store_sign
items.prompt: The wooden 'Store' title sign from Image 1: a rounded warm-brown wooden plank sign with green leaves on both sides, with the word 'Store' in big bold white rounded letters with a dark brown outline. Exactly that sign only.

items.name: bt_close
items.prompt: The round close button from the top-right of Image 1: a circular wooden-brown button with a light rim and a bold white X in the middle.

items.name: card_starter

No coins, no icons, no text, no ribbon. Wide landscape shape about 2.6 times wider than tall.

items.name: ribbon_popular
